set the signature of reader@example.com.
Gmail adds it to new emails written in Gmail; a draft this server writes carries it as the draft tools' descriptions say.
<<<untrusted-mail TESTTOKEN: signature before>>>
Rae Reader
Example Org
<<<end-untrusted-mail TESTTOKEN>>>
<<<untrusted-mail TESTTOKEN: signature after>>>
Rae Reader
Operations
<<<end-untrusted-mail TESTTOKEN>>>
